title: Spring Actuator environment dump
description: A Spring Actuator environment document appears in the response body. The dump lists every property source the application resolved, including datasource URLs and the values of unencrypted credentials, and it is served unauthenticated by default.
remediation: Expose only health and info on the management port and require authentication for the rest.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches the activeProfiles or propertySources key of the environment document; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.
scopeT: A response body that carries a Spring Actuator environment document.
fp: A page that documents the actuator path without the JSON keys is not reported.
recordDesc: A Spring Actuator environment document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The dump lists every property source the application resolved, including datasource URLs and the values of unencrypted credentials, and it is served unauthenticated by default.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator environment document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The dump lists every property source the application resolved, including datasource URLs and the values of unencrypted credentials, and it is served unauthenticated by default.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Expose only health and info on the management port and require authentication for the rest.
Set management.endpoints.web.exposure.include to health,info in the production profile.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a Spring Actuator environment document.

observation.body: Management endpoints are restricted to the operations network.
